# CFB Social

> CFB Social is a free college football fan community covering all 653 FBS and FCS programs, and the home for EA Sports College Football 27 (CFB 27) players. Fans post takes that the community votes "Touchdown" or "Fumble," debate rivalries head-to-head, track the transfer portal, file predictions that age into "receipts," follow live game-day threads, and use the Game Room to share dynasty screenshots, build flip-magazines of their season, and find online dynasty leagues across PS5, Xbox, and PC.

CFB Social is not affiliated with or endorsed by EA Sports or Electronic Arts. All College Football 27 content is user-generated.

## Main sections

- [Feed](https://www.cfbsocial.com/feed): The community feed of college football takes; each take is voted "Touchdown" (agree) or "Fumble" (disagree).
- [Schools](https://www.cfbsocial.com/schools): Fan hubs for all 653 FBS and FCS programs, each with that school's feed, top fans, rivalries, recruiting activity, and CFB 27 dynasty moments.
- [Transfer Portal Wire](https://www.cfbsocial.com/portal): Transfer portal tracking, filterable by position, star rating, and status, with fan "claims" on where players land.
- [War Room](https://www.cfbsocial.com/war-room): Live game-day threads with real-time chat and live scores pulled from the day's games.
- [Rivalry Ring](https://www.cfbsocial.com/rivalry): Head-to-head fan debates and one-on-one challenges the community votes on.
- [Predictions](https://www.cfbsocial.com/predictions): File a prediction and it locks in with a timestamp; as it ages it becomes a "receipt" that proves who called it first.
- [Recruiting](https://www.cfbsocial.com/recruiting): Recruiting and transfer-portal activity heat map by program.
- [Mascot Wars](https://www.cfbsocial.com/mascot-wars): A 64-team mascot bracket tournament decided entirely by fan vote.
- [Dynasty Mode](https://www.cfbsocial.com/dynasty): XP, levels, and achievements as fans climb from Walk-On to Hall of Fame.
- [Hall of Fame](https://www.cfbsocial.com/hall-of-fame): Leaderboards for top fans, most accurate predictors, and dynasty leaders.

## Game Room (College Football 27)

- [Game Room](https://www.cfbsocial.com/game-room): Share College Football 27 dynasty screenshots ("moments"), curate them into a flip-magazine of your season, and find online leagues.
- [Online Dynasty Leagues](https://www.cfbsocial.com/game-room/leagues): Directory of open CFB 27 online dynasty leagues to join, filterable by platform (PS5, Xbox, PC), cross-play, sim schedule, and open schools.
- [Game Room Guide](https://www.cfbsocial.com/game-room/guide): How to share moments, build an issue, and join an online dynasty.

## Rivalry & conference hubs

Durable, evergreen pages with series history, all-time context, and live fan debate. Matchup URLs use alphabetical slug order (`/matchup/{schoolA}-vs-{schoolB}`).

- [The Iron Bowl — Alabama vs Auburn](https://www.cfbsocial.com/matchup/alabama-vs-auburn)
- [The Game — Ohio State vs Michigan](https://www.cfbsocial.com/matchup/michigan-vs-ohio-state)
- [The Red River Rivalry — Texas vs Oklahoma](https://www.cfbsocial.com/matchup/oklahoma-vs-texas)
- [Florida vs Georgia (World's Largest Outdoor Cocktail Party)](https://www.cfbsocial.com/matchup/florida-vs-georgia)
- [The Jeweled Shillelagh — USC vs Notre Dame](https://www.cfbsocial.com/matchup/notre-dame-vs-usc)
- [Conference hubs](https://www.cfbsocial.com/conferences/sec): SEC, Big Ten, Big 12, ACC, Pac-12, American, Sun Belt, Conference USA, MAC, Mountain West, and Independents.
- A fuller index of rivalry hubs and key facts is in [llms-full.txt](https://www.cfbsocial.com/llms-full.txt).

## Key answers

- What is CFB Social: a free social network for college football fans and CFB 27 players, covering all 653 FBS/FCS programs.
- Is it free: yes. Signing up, posting, listing a league, and joining are all free. No credit card required.
- What "Touchdown" and "Fumble" mean: the community's up-vote and down-vote on a take.
- What a "receipt" is: a prediction that has aged past its revisit date, providing timestamped proof of who called it first.
- Where to share College Football 27 screenshots: the Game Room "Moments" tab; each upload posts to your feed and can be added to your magazine.
- How to find a CFB 27 online dynasty league: browse the Leagues directory at /game-room/leagues, open a league, and request a spot.
- Platforms for CFB 27: PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC.
